overall_notes: This paper focuses on multimodal aspect-based sentiment analysis using generated face descriptions and image captions. While it generates textual outputs (face descriptions and captions), the primary task is sentiment analysis rather than NLG evaluation. The metrics used (Accuracy, Macro-F1) evaluate the sentiment classification performance, not the quality of the generated text itself. No human evaluation or LLM-based evaluation is conducted.
